facts.plan_summary: This is a modular overseas travel insurance plan designed to cover medical emergencies, hospitalization, and incidental expenses during travel. It allows customers to select from multiple plan options and add-ons to suit specific travel insurance needs.
facts.target_customer: Individuals and corporates travelling overseas, including senior citizens (Super Age plan) and groups (Corporate Lite/Plus), up to age 120 years.
facts.free_look_period: You may terminate this Policy at any time before the commencement of the Risk Period, by giving Us written notice and the Policy shall terminate.
key_benefits: No pre-policy medical health check-up required
Multiple sum insured options from USD 50,000 to USD 500,000
Personal accident and accidental death & disability cover
Coverage for loss of passport, baggage, and trip interruption
Pre-existing illness cover (up to USD 3,000 for life-threatening conditions)
major_exclusions: The Insured Person's participation in any naval, military or air force operations whether in the form of military exercises or war games or actual engagement with the enemy, whether foreign or domestic.

War, invasion, acts of foreign enemy, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war, civil unrest, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power or confiscation or nationalization or requisition of or destruction of or damage to property by or under the order of any government or local authority.

The loss or destruction or damage to any property whatsoever or any loss or expenses whatsoever resulting or arising there from or any consequential loss directly or indirectly caused by or contributed to or arising from: Ionising radiation or contamination by radioactivity form any nuclear waste from combustion of nuclear fuel; or The radioactive, toxic, explosive or other hazardous properties of any explosive nuclear assembly or nuclear component thereof, or Asbestosis or any related Sickness or Disease resulting from the existence, production, handling, processing, manufacture, sale, distribution, deposit or use of asbestos, or products thereof.
The Insured Person's actual or attempted engagement in any criminal or other unlawful act.

In respect of travel by the Insured Person to any country against whom the Republic of India has imposed general or special travel restrictions, or against whom it may impose such restrictions, or any country which has imposed or may impose subsequently, such restrictions against travel by a citizen of the Republic of India to such country.

Travel Ace by Bajaj General (Travel).
UIN: BAJTIOP24008V022324
Plan summary: This is a modular overseas travel insurance plan designed to cover medical emergencies, hospitalization, and incidental expenses during travel. It allows customers to select from multiple plan options and add-ons to suit specific travel insurance needs.
Who it is for: Individuals and corporates travelling overseas, including senior citizens (Super Age plan) and groups (Corporate Lite/Plus), up to age 120 years.

Optional riders / add-ons: Lifestyle Modification Benefit; Child Education Benefit; Accidental Death & Disability-Common Carrier (AD&D); Personal Accident Cover in India; Pre-Existing Injury Cover; Waiver of Sub-limits
